meta.title: Suggestions to improve decision-making — review queue
meta.policy: Proposals are listed for review; status must be set to approved before any implementation branch may edit the referenced files. Proposing a change does not imply it is correct.

proposal_review_rule: Reviewer changes status from proposed to approved / rejected / in_progress. Approved proposals may be implemented on a named branch with a linked PR; rejected ones stay as record. No direct-to-main edits for approved items — all pass CI.

rows.proposal: Add a decision-gate page that must be completed before any wager or allocation
rows.detail: A short checklist (model vs close? closing-price cost? injury deltas? execution verified?) that blocks the decision if a required field is blank. Keeps the dashboard from being used as a tip sheet.
rows.expected_impact: Prevents premature risk-taking; aligns with G9 executable gate that currently fails for every strategy.

rows.proposal: Publish a Have / Don't Have inventory for every signal feature
rows.detail: For each candidate input (rest days, wind, past margin, injury tags, depth-chart tier, Next Gen tracking aggregates) list source feed, timestamp rule, missingness per season, and whether it is point-in-time. Turns the vague 'missing information' note into a field-by-field spec.
rows.expected_impact: Makes REQ-03 answerable: reviewers can see exactly which inputs are hypothetical vs measured.

rows.proposal: Build a live injury & depth-chart tracker from official NFL feeds
rows.detail: Daily scrape pattern: at 4pm ET practice-report deadline, ingest /injuries/league/<season>/regN; map Player→Team→Position→DepthRank from official depth charts (e.g., colts.com/team/depth-chart and nfl.com/teams/<team>/roster). Emit per-team depth-deficiency signal: starter out + backup tier, with explicit unknown when depth missing. Do not invent tiers; publish the roster sentence that was read.
rows.expected_impact: Closes REQ-10 gap. Gives offense/defense deficiency scores that can be gated rather than guessed.

rows.proposal: Separate the injury-report policy citation into confirmed vs 404 components
rows.detail: The Competition Committee status-definition article is confirmed; the operations.nfl.com/football-ops/league-governance/injury-report/ page returns no article body and is 404. Split the citation so the confirmed definitions still support the tracker, while the 404 is retained as a flagged item rather than a silent source.
rows.expected_impact: Improves citation precision without dropping a useful page.

rows.proposal: Upgrade the source register to record HTTP status and excerpt per source on the day it was read
rows.detail: Add two columns already used by verification: http_state and excerpt. The Source register page would then show what the reader actually saw, not just that a URL exists.
rows.expected_impact: Moves from link collection to verifiable reading record; directly supports manual review.

rows.proposal: Add weather enrichment as a first-class field in games.csv.gz with explicit coverage flag
rows.detail: Match each outdoor game to forecast.weather.gov point forecast by stadium lat/lon at the day-of-game 12Z issuance; store wind_gust, temp, precip and a weather_available boolean. Historical coverage will stay ~57% for 2020-2026 outdoors (verified in prior flagged entry); the boolean stops silent fallbacks to domestic means.
rows.expected_impact: Makes S7 wind-under testable on new seasons without re-introducing the 219-row no-price bias that collapsed it from +8.65% to +7.14%.

rows.proposal: Record closing-price exclusion counts as first-class metrics beside every ROI table
rows.detail: Every backtest row currently publishes n, decided, pushes via lib/backtest. Extend to n_excluded_missing_price per side (already in results/*.json after PR #52) and show it in the UI. Prevents silent -110 imputation from reappearing.
rows.expected_impact: Makes the price-integrity fix durable across future generators.

rows.proposal: Introduce a controlled parlay pricing mode that uses measured correlations instead of naive multiplication
rows.detail: For correlated same-team legs (QB→WR1 r=0.562), price with a bivariate-normal copula calibrated to the measured r (ρ≈0.60) rather than p1×p2. Show both naive and correlation-aware break-even prices; only the latter counts for gate G4.
rows.expected_impact: Prevents overstating parlay value; aligns with the flagged push-handling and parlay-ladder notes.

rows.proposal: Keep the leaderboard reward schedule as a paper schedule until G9 can be verified
rows.detail: Tier badges and reward descriptions stay labelled as design proposal; no cash or allocation is implied. Add a one-line ledger on the leaderboard page that records the date each tier was last considered for funding and the outcome.
rows.expected_impact: Prevents REQ-05 presentation from implying funded prizes; keeps competition incentive without misrepresentation.

rows.proposal: Add a weekly reconciliation job that compares rebuilt standings against NFL.com before any new model is published
rows.detail: Extend the existing 2020/2026 recomputation to run weekly in CI: download NFL.com division standings, rebuild from committed games.csv.gz, fail the workflow if >0 teams mismatch. The verification page already does this spot check; automation would make staleness immediately visible.
rows.expected_impact: Closes the 2026 staleness risk that previously left the site a week behind the official table.

rows.proposal: Expose the archive navigation from the root dashboard so sibling labs are discoverable
rows.detail: The root pages/archive.html already lists dashboard/, nfl-lines/, nfl-research/, research-desk/, origination-lab/, quant-lab/, skill-lab/ etc. Add a first-class nav link from the sidebar to Archive so a reviewer does not need to guess that sibling work exists.
rows.expected_impact: Improves discoverability of work that is already published but unlinked from the main nav.

rows.proposal: Replace edition-stale operator citations with the active 10.7.26 house-rules PDF and re-read the cited settlement sentences
rows.detail: The flagged FL-11 notes the 8.1.24 edition is archived as obsolete since 8.18.15. Point citations at DraftKings-House-Rules-10.7.26.pdf and re-fetch the exact push/parlay/teaser sentences that the site quotes; keep the old edition as a historical note rather than a live source.
rows.expected_impact: Removes a known medium-flagged irregularity from the live site.
